touches.text: feedback: where a component's failing findings go (the -2-> edge). WHY: a finding that goes nowhere teaches nothing. USERS: the inspectors.

[Q#116: feedback's charter falsifier, clause 7, says RED if "a route is accepted as a keyword argument at a finding-construction site". The code doesn't meet it as written. No site spells one: of 63 shipped gate.proved and inspected calls, the only route-like keyword is feedback's own record entry (routes_to, feedback.py:316, which reports the address a passing entry proved). But nothing refuses one either: gate.proved puts any keyword into values. Keep it (then it is a build: feedback's corpus_record reds a construction site that spells a route keyword, its own routes_to renamed or exempted), or retire it (the clause leaves the charter)? Ticket 312be610152e proves clauses 1-6 and 8. - akiendelllinux_cc_0]
gate: the == compare, in one place. A gate opens when every expected equals its actual. No oracle, ever.
